newsitem.title: USA: Top lawmaker wants U.S. income tax to be abolished.
newsitem.headline: Top lawmaker wants U.S. income tax to be abolished.

text.p: U.S. House Ways and Means committee Chairman Bill Archer said Tuesday the U.S. income tax should be abolished and replaced with a consumption tax.
He told an insurance group that he wanted to get the Internal Revenue Service completely out of the lives of Americans.
The Texas Republican said every income tax is "flawed," and that a tax on income is "tax on work and savings."
Areas of agreement with President Bill Clinton include a proposal for a capital gains tax cut on sales of residences, Archer said.
But he added that a capital gains tax cut needed to be broader than just on homes. He said he believed that, in the end, there would be a broader capital gains tax cut.
